This is the community analysis of the hydrobios stratified net tows to contextualize the results of the lipid pump analysis.

Questions to answer:
1. What are the other dominant copepods and their body sizes? - resolved
2. What % of the zooplankton abundance are accounted for by copepods? 
3. What % of the copepod abundance are accounted for by Calanus spp.?
4. Are there regional differences on what is the dominant Calanus species?
5. Could seasonally variation in life stages per Calanus species be observed with the data?

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libaries and data files
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

fname <- "data/2023-2024-taxo_analyses_data_patrickPata-20260203.xlsx"

# 
hydrobios <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  fname,
  sheet = "zooplankton abundances",
  # To resolve expected numeric [the sampling net ID is loaded as numeric]
  col_types = c("text","text","text","text","text","numeric","text","numeric",
                "numeric","numeric","text","text","text","text","text","text",
                "text","numeric")) %>% 
  rename(abundance_m3 = `Total abundance (ind./m3 depth computed vol)`,
         volume_filtered_m3 = depth_calc_net_filtered_vol)

hydrobios.meta <- readxl::read_xlsx(fname,
                               sheet = "sampling details")

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
```

# Taxonomy check
```{r}
# Ocurrence per entire hydrobios station
taxa.count <- hydrobios %>% 
  distinct(STATION_NAME, STATION_NAME, TAXON_ID) %>% 
  group_by(TAXON_ID) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  arrange(-n)

# TODO Assign all taxa with occurrence counts <10 (20% of the profiles) as "others"
taxa.others <- taxa.count %>% 
  filter(n < 10)
```

# List the copepods and get their body lengths
1. What are the other dominant copepods and their body sizes? - resolved
```{r}
# Dataset of lifestage specific size for Arctic species
df.dur <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/New_Trait_Data_For_Database/Durazzano_holoplankton_Arctic_traits/Dataset_marine_holoplankton_Arctic.csv", sep = ";") %>% 
  filter(class == "Copepoda") %>% 
  mutate(dryWeight_mg = dryWeight/1000) %>% 
  mutate(lifeStage = if_else(lifeStage == "Adult", sex, lifeStage)) %>% 
  select(taxa = acceptedNameUsage, lifeStage, 
         meanBodyLength, prosomeLength) %>% 
  # rename stages to match the database names
  mutate(lifeStage = case_when(
    lifeStage == "Female" ~ "F",
    lifeStage == "Male" ~ "M",
    lifeStage == "Copepodite stage I" ~ "C1",
    lifeStage == "Copepodite stage II" ~ "C2",
    lifeStage == "Copepodite stage III" ~ "C3",
    lifeStage == "Copepodite stage IV" ~ "C4",
    lifeStage == "Copepodite stage V" ~ "C5"))

# Subset of copepods in the hydrobios dataset
taxa.copepods <- hydrobios %>% 
  filter(CLASS == "Copepoda") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(FAMILY)) %>% # "Copepoda" or "Calanoida" or "Harpacticoida"
  filter(TAXON_ID != FAMILY) %>% 
  filter(TAXON_ID %notin% taxa.others$TAXON_ID) %>% 
  group_by(ORDER, FAMILY, TAXON_ID, TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE) %>% 
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance_m3),
            occurrence = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Remove the sp. and spp.
  mutate(taxa = gsub("\\bsp\\.|\\bspp\\.", "", TAXON_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(genus = sub(" .*", "", taxa)) %>% 
  rename(lifeStage = TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE) %>% 
  # adjust taxa names to match df.dur
  mutate(taxa = if_else(taxa == "Metridia longa", "Metridia longa longa", taxa)) %>% 
  mutate(taxa = if_else(taxa == "Oncaea notopus/parila", "Oncaea parila", taxa)) %>% 
  mutate(taxa = if_else(taxa == "Scolecithricella minor", "Scolecithricella minor minor", taxa)) %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = paste(taxa, lifeStage)) 

taxa.copepods.size <- taxa.copepods %>% 
  filter(taxa %in% df.dur$taxa) %>% 
  left_join(df.dur %>% 
              select(taxa, lifeStage, meanBodyLength, prosomeLength),
            by = join_by(lifeStage, taxa))

# Pseudocalanus spp. can be multiple species but all mean body length <1.9mm
aa <- taxa.copepods %>% 
  filter(taxa %notin% df.dur$taxa) %>% 
  filter(genus %notin% taxa.copepods.size$genus) %>% 
  distinct(taxa, .keep_all = T)


# Large copepods > 2 mm
large.copepods <- taxa.copepods.size %>% 
  filter(meanBodyLength>2 | prosomeLength >2) %>% 
  arrange(-meanBodyLength)%>% 
  mutate(perc_occurrence = (occurrence / 369) * 100) %>% 
  relocate(taxaStage, mean_abundance, perc_occurrence, meanBodyLength, prosomeLength) %>% 
  filter(genus %notin% c("Calanus")) %>%
  filter(meanBodyLength >= 3)

ggplot(large.copepods, aes(x = meanBodyLength, y = perc_occurrence , 
                           color = mean_abundance)) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = taxaStage), hjust = 0)
```


# Curate the data
```{r}
mesozoop <- hydrobios %>% 
  filter(KINGDOM == "Animalia") %>% 
  # Reduce the number of taxa
  mutate(TAXON_ID = if_else(TAXON_ID %in% taxa.others$TAXON_ID,
                            "Others", TAXON_ID)) %>% 
   # Assign dates
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, DEPLOYMENT_TIME_START))) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(datetime),
         month = month(datetime),
         doy = yday(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  # Calculate depth  range and midpoint
  mutate(Depth_range = MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH - MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_mid = (MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH + MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) / 2) %>% 
  # Remove the sp. and spp.
  mutate(taxa = gsub("\\bsp\\.|\\bspp\\.", "", TAXON_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(genus = sub(" .*", "", taxa)) %>% 
  rename(lifeStage = TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE) %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = paste(taxa, lifeStage)) %>% 
  # remove the repeated counts for RA62
  filter(!(YEAR_STATION == "2024 RA62" & SAMPLING_NET_ID %in% c("6","7")))
  

hydrobios.meta <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
   # Assign dates
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, DEPLOYMENT_TIME_START))) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(datetime),
         month = month(datetime),
         doy = yday(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  # Calculate depth  range and midpoint
  mutate(Depth_range = MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH - MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_mid = (MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH + MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) / 2)

colnames(net.data)
```

```{r}
  group_by(year, month) %>%

ggplot(hydrobios.meta, aes(x = doy, y = LATITUDE)) +

```

# Composition
2. What % of the zooplankton abundance are accounted for by copepods? 
3. What % of the copepod abundance are accounted for by Calanus spp.?
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# percent copepods (86.4%)
class.summary <- mesozoop %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH, Depth_mid,
           year, month, doy, CLASS) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # total mesozoop abundance in a sample
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
         percent_abundance = (abundance_m3 / total_abundance_m3) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(CLASS) %>% 
  summarize(percent_abundance_mean = mean(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_sd = sd(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_min = min(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_max = max(percent_abundance),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-percent_abundance_mean)

# Calanoids % copepods
order.summary <- mesozoop %>% 
  filter(CLASS == "Copepoda") %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH, Depth_mid,
           year, month, doy, ORDER) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # total mesozoop abundance in a sample
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
         percent_abundance = (abundance_m3 / total_abundance_m3) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(ORDER) %>% 
  summarize(percent_abundance_mean = mean(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_sd = sd(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_min = min(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_max = max(percent_abundance),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-percent_abundance_mean)


# Calanidae % Calanoida (%)
family.summary <- mesozoop %>% 
  filter(ORDER == "Calanoida") %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH, Depth_mid,
           year, month, doy, FAMILY) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # total mesozoop abundance in a sample
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
         percent_abundance = (abundance_m3 / total_abundance_m3) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(FAMILY) %>% 
  summarize(percent_abundance_mean = mean(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_sd = sd(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_min = min(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_max = max(percent_abundance),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-percent_abundance_mean)

# Calanus % Calanoida (21)
taxa.summary <- mesozoop %>% 
  filter(ORDER == "Calanoida") %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH, Depth_mid,
           year, month, doy, taxa) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # total mesozoop abundance in a sample
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3),
         percent_abundance = (abundance_m3 / total_abundance_m3) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(taxa) %>% 
  summarize(percent_abundance_mean = mean(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_sd = sd(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_min = min(percent_abundance),
            percent_abundance_max = max(percent_abundance),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-percent_abundance_mean)
```

# Calanus spp.
4. Are there regional differences on what is the dominant Calanus species?
5. Could seasonally variation in life stages per Calanus species be observed with the data?
 - Cant really differentiate months. Even C1-C5 difference in abundance between 2023 and 2024 is high, so using the A-transect for Aug 2023 vs TCAT/A-trasect for Oct 2024 would not be reliable.
```{r}
# community composition by station
stn.calanus <- mesozoop %>% 
  filter(genus %in% c("Calanus","Metridia")) %>% 
  filter(lifeStage != "Cop-NS") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * Depth_range) %>% 
  # vertical integration
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, taxaStage, taxa, lifeStage, 
           year, month, doy) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            max_depth = max(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH),
            nlayers = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
# TODO assign regions and latitude
  left_join(distinct(hydrobios.meta,
                     YEAR_STATION, LONGITUDE, LATITUDE),
            by = "YEAR_STATION")


ggplot(stn.calanus, aes(x = STATION_NAME, y = abundance_m2,
           fill = taxa)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("turquoise","pink","hotpink","orange")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~year, scales = "free_x")

ggplot(stn.calanus, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = abundance_m2,
           fill = lifeStage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "gray20") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(~taxa)
```

# TODO Calculate % of stages per species in depth layers
This is similar to Fig 2b in Schmidt et al. (2025)
```{r}
select_stations <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
  # exclude the stations that are 1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8+9
  filter(STATION_NAME %notin% c("122","322","325")) %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION) %>% 
  mutate(max_depth = max(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # Select the few very deep stations
  filter(max_depth >= 500) %>% 
  distinct(YEAR_STATION, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  # some stations have no surface samples??
  filter()
  
# per sample-species-stage, calculate the % of the population in the upper X  m of the water column
calanus.depth <- mesozoop %>% 
  filter(genus %in% c("Calanus")) %>% 
  filter(lifeStage != "Cop-NS") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * Depth_range) %>% 
  # TODO curate out the stations that dont differentiate surface 150/250m
  # calculate the depth-integrated total abundance of sample-species-stage
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, taxaStage) %>% 
  mutate(total_abund_m2 = sum(abundance_m2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(perc_abund = (abundance_m2 / total_abund_m2) * 100) %>% 
  filter(STATION_NAME %in% select_stations$STATION_NAME) %>% 
  # Group to upper 150 or lower 150
  mutate(surface150 = if_else(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH <= 150, T, F)) %>% 
  left_join(select_stations %>% 
              distinct(YEAR_STATION, LATITUDE))

ggplot(calanus.depth %>% 
         filter(taxaStage == "Calanus hyperboreus F"),
       aes(y = perc_abund, x = MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH,
                          color = YEAR_STATION)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = surface150)) + 
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

perc_surf <- calanus.depth %>% 
  filter(lifeStage %in% c("C4","C5","F")) %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, surface150, doy, year,LATITUDE,
           taxaStage, taxa, lifeStage, total_abund_m2) %>% 
  summarise(perc_abund = sum(perc_abund),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(perc_surf %>% 
         # filter(taxaStage == "Calanus hyperboreus C5") %>% 
         filter(surface150 == T),
       aes(x = doy, y = perc_abund)) +
  geom_smooth(se = F, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_point(aes(color = LATITUDE)) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(228,244,259, 274, 289), 
                     labels = c("228(Aug)","244(Sep)","259(Sep)","274(Oct)","289(Oct)")) +
  ylab("Populatin in upper 150 m (%)") +
  xlab("Day of Year") +
  facet_grid(lifeStage~taxa) +
  ggtitle("n=25 stations deeper than 500 m")

ggsave("figures/check_percent150m_calanus.png",
       height = 7, width = 8, units = "in", bg = "white")
```


# Sampling distribution map
```{r}
library(ggOceanMaps)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

net_meta <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
  filter(YEAR_STATION %in% select_stations$YEAR_STATION) %>% 
  distinct(YEAR_STATION, year, month, doy, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(month = as.factor(month))

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,65,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "gray60",  bathy.style = "contour_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = net_meta,
                                aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE,
                                    shape = month,
                                    color = doy),
                                size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = net_meta,
                                aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE,
                                    label = STATION_NAME), size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1,
                       name = "DOY") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) +
  facet_wrap(~year)
```
